sections.title: Section 1
sections.subtitle: We sit at the intersection of marketing strategy, creative technology, and data science-and we build AI products that reflect that.
sections.description: Our team brings together people who have spent years working on real campaigns, for real brands, across every discipline that modern marketing demands. We don't build tools in isolation from the work - we build them because we do the work, and we know exactly where the gaps are. Every product we ship started as a problem one of us encountered on a real brief.
